purpose: Join provider usage custody to a compiled GUI caller, per-action release and durable outcome/effect receipts in a finite synthetic experiment.
question: Does the current-main integration path preserve provider call identity/usage, compiled execution outcome and durable effect custody, while stopping before a second action when an intermediate dependency changes?
hypotheses: Synthetic positive case joins exactly one provider attempt and token event to a two-transition compiled execution and independently scored durable task effect.
Synthetic changed-intermediate case joins the same provider accounting to a one-transition partial execution, releases input, performs no second admission/action, and persists no task-effect receipt.

design.provider: local deterministic Codex App Server JSONL peer; no external provider
design.interface: existing current-main runtime/core_v1 compiled GUI path
design.task: deterministic synthetic form with independent state-based task scorer
design.coarse_candidate: caller-provided fixture; this is not a cold-route economics comparison

pass_criteria: Both interpreter modes exit zero and emit one passing test.
Each case has one token-usage protocol event, joined by provider turn and thread identifiers to the caller attempt ledger; exact synthetic usage vector agrees with caller totals.

Positive case executes enter_value and submit with two eligible admissions and verified all-input-released receipts, then stores compiled execution and independent task-effect receipts; durable audit status is audited.

Changed-intermediate case stops after enter_value, has no submit admission/action, reports EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE / unknown_state / confirmed_partial, stores execution receipt and has no independent score or effect receipt.
Independent auditor rechecks frozen source hashes, raw output hashes, protocol joins, scenario summaries and durable allocation audits.
stop_rules: Any unexpected action/admission, missing release proof, stale dependency not stopping continuation, duplicate provider call, mismatched usage/call/thread identity, missing custody receipt, source drift, or process/audit failure means this packet does not pass; preserve artifacts and diagnose without retrying this frozen attempt.
limits: Synthetic-only. No physical GUI, user desktop, external model/provider, WSLc, Docker, runtime packaging, MAP01, delayed stale input injection or recovery reliability was exercised.
No prices/cost/latency comparison or matched economics conclusion.
Two fixture cases in two Python modes do not establish product acceptance or research-preview graduation.
